items.title: City (Vault)
items.summary: TL;DR City (Vault) is a web challenge from WebSecDojo. This challenge tests the ability to analyze HTTP protocols, manipulate headers, understand client-side logic (JavaScript), and brute forcing techniques in multilevel authentication forms. items.title: Portal
items.summary: TL;DR Portal is a web challenge from WebSecDojo. This challenge involves a web application with multiple vulnerabilities. The goal is to obtain three flags by analyzing exposed endpoints, client-side JavaScript, and leaked source code. items.title: The Bank
items.summary: TL;DR The Bank is a web challenge from WebSecDojo. This challenge focuses on modern banking applications that have vulnerabilities on the API side. The goal is to exploit weak authorization mechanisms to access other users’ data and obtain flags. Challenge Overview This challenge focuses on modern banking applications that have vulnerabilities on the API side.
